scripts.build:parser: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 -m pip install -r am-parser/requirements.txt
scripts.build:all: npm run clean && npm run build:common && npm run build:data && npm run build:parser
scripts.build:data:kafka: node scripts/run-with-logs.js node scripts/build-module.js data kafka
scripts.build:data:api: node scripts/run-with-logs.js node scripts/build-module.js data api
scripts.build:data:all: node scripts/run-with-logs.js node scripts/build-module.js data ALL
scripts.build:common:model: node scripts/run-with-logs.js node scripts/build-module.js common model
scripts.build:common:service: node scripts/run-with-logs.js node scripts/build-module.js common service
scripts.build:common:all: node scripts/run-with-logs.js node scripts/build-module.js common ALL
scripts.dev:env:data: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npm run env:dev --prefix am-market-data
scripts.preprod:env:data: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npm run env:preprod --prefix am-market-data
scripts.preprod:run:data: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npm run run:preprod --prefix am-market-data
scripts.preprod:run:data:fast: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npm run run:preprod:fast --prefix am-market-data
scripts.test: node scripts/run-with-logs.js npx -y concurrently "cd am-parser && am test" "cd am-market-data && am test"
scripts.deploy:preprod:parser: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/test_publish.py am-parser --env preprod
scripts.deploy:preprod:data: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/test_publish.py am-market-data --env preprod
scripts.deploy:prod:parser: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/test_publish.py am-parser --env prod
scripts.deploy:prod:data: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/test_publish.py am-market-data --env prod
scripts.sdk:market:python: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/build_sdk.py --service market --lang python
scripts.sdk:market:java: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/build_sdk.py --service market --lang java
scripts.sdk:market:flutter: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/build_sdk.py --service market --lang flutter
scripts.sdk:parser:python: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/build_sdk.py --service parser --lang python
scripts.sdk:parser:java: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/build_sdk.py --service parser --lang java
scripts.sdk:parser:flutter: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/build_sdk.py --service parser --lang flutter
scripts.sdk:all: node scripts/run-with-logs.js python3 scripts/build_sdk.py --service all --lang all
